findings_of_record: BATCH-PATH GAP (not exercised here, fix = separate PR, never a silent lane patch): review-writes.ts validateAllForPaper resolves schemes via schemeForVersion (order by created_at desc limit 1) — a pre-ruling-A shape assuming one scheme per version. Under ruling A, 109 wave-1 versions carry 2 part-bound LEVELS schemes each (max 2; 431 schemes over 322 versions), so a paper-level batch flip would flip only the newest scheme per version and leave the sibling part-bound scheme SUGGESTED. The per-scheme seam used by this receipt is unaffected (explicit schemeId end-to-end).

RUNNER FRAGILITY (disclosed, lane-only): one NeonWsClient session per runner process; long runs over the remote pooler hit a shell timeout (pass 1) and a WebSocket drop (pass 2, post-flip snapshot read).
